fact: The partnership compact of March 2024 states that Burundi has a functional SIGE through which the MENRS technical directorates regularly produce statistical yearbooks, and commits the priority reform to revising the national strategy for strengthening the SIGE and the school map, to the progressive decentralisation of the SIGE, to digitalising data collection and to training school heads in keeping school registers; it names no system holding a record per learner.
title: Vers une amélioration équitable et inclusive de la qualité des apprentissages: Pacte de Partenariat pour la Transformation du système éducatif burundais
publisher: Gouvernement du Burundi / Partenariat mondial pour l'éducation
